{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
df["revenue"] = df["revenue"].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue_completed = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_revenue_completed"}
